description: Retrospective research biomarker observation normalized from NASA OSD-575.

field_semantics.observation_id: Stable identifier derived from study and upstream source-row provenance.
field_semantics.subject_id: Study pseudonymous crew identifier as present in source data.
field_semantics.timepoint_text: Exact source visit/timepoint label; not a calendar timestamp.
field_semantics.measured_at_utc: Null unless an explicit timestamp exists in the source; this notebook does not synthesize one.
field_semantics.health_domain: Conservative assay-family grouping: metabolic, immune, cardiovascular, or unclassified.
field_semantics.value: Numeric value parsed by Notebook 03; preserve unit alongside it.
field_semantics.unit: Original unit from source; not inferred.
field_semantics.clinical_interpretation: Always null in this export; no diagnosis or clinical interpretation is generated.
field_semantics.is_live_telemetry: Always false; these are retrospective research observations.

source_selection: Reads only osd575_measurements_long_primary.csv produced by Notebook 03.
